canonical_name: Tietze extension theorem for continuous functions on closed subsets
literal_source_claim_zh: 正规空间中闭集上连续函数的延拓
literal_source_claim_en: Extension of continuous functions on closed subsets of normal spaces.
statement_blocker: The catalog omits the codomain, boundedness and range-preservation clauses, normality/T1 convention, ordered binders, and boundary cases. Tietze 1915 Satz 3 is a bounded real-valued theorem for a closed subset of a Frechet metric space; pinned mathlib supplies bounded and unbounded normal-space forms. Selecting one or treating the historical-to-modern implication as automatic would broaden, narrow, or substitute the target without the required independent source review.
